items.name: Claude Ads patterns
items.reason: Useful ads patterns are represented in provider-neutral planning inside existing marketing/evaluation engines. No Claude runtime dependency is introduced.

items.name: ads audit
items.reason: Deterministic ads-readiness auditing exists without spend, budget mutation, platform write or publication authority.

items.name: competitor ads scan
items.reason: Public/authorized competitor-ad scanning is represented as a plan over COMPET-001; it inherits the current-main COMPET physical runtime gap already routed through item 57 rather than creating a second scanner.

items.name: creative testing
items.reason: Creative experimentation can be planned/evaluated with existing engines while publish and spend side effects remain disabled.

items.name: landing experimentation
items.reason: Landing experiments compose existing marketing/acquisition/evaluation/web engines; no website write or publish occurs in this scope.

items.name: existing SEO
items.reason: SEO-001 is explicitly preserved and wrapped, never replaced. WordPress/GSC/SEO mutations remain off until their existing contracts and physical adapters are verified.

items.name: local SEO
items.reason: Local SEO planning composes SEO-001 and LOCALP-001. No GBP write is authorized and no new local-SEO engine is justified.

items.name: social audit
items.reason: Public/authorized social audit is read-only and composes existing SOCAUD/MKT capabilities; no social write or publication is enabled.

items.name: C15T / LibreConsent
items.reason: Consent-tool benchmark only. Installation/config mutation/subscription are disabled and this item is not claimed as a full CONS-001 implementation.

items.name: Google / Meta offline conversion feedback
items.reason: Offline-conversion feedback is represented as an opaque-reference learning plan; Google/Meta uploads remain disabled and execution without validated consent would require LEGAL_REQUIRED.
